res[0] = X0 (train 0 gets X0 passengers). latest[v] = latest arrival time + passengers at v.

For each event in sorted order:

- kind=0 (arrival of train i): latest[B[i]] = max(latest[B[i]], T[i] + res[i]).

This is the classic ABC problem (ABC E - Waiting for Trains or similar). Train 1 (index 0) gets X0 = 100 passengers.
